classification: source-informed frozen orchestration contracts; not independent chemistry forecasts
refusal_boundary: Malformed input or candidate: Err with complete bench/stock/history unchanged, before applies/solve/safety hooks. Safety veto: unchanged physical state/stock, exactly one veto event and one attempt log.
supported_boundary: A valid one-increment dose reaches safety and solver; 0.1 mol/L times0.001L supplies0.0001mol NaOH. Valid zero increment limit is a logged noop without hooks. No aqueous solver/pH or endpoint convergence claim.
rollback_scope: These controls cover admission and first trial only. Accepted prior increments, solver-error outcomes and bisection/final-safety rollback require separately frozen follow-up controls.
requirement: First archive hosted baseline named outcomes on unchanged source. Port fixture byte-identically only after PR773 is integrated or its final acceptance is otherwise complete; freeze later fixtures before any repair.
